# pdf.js 4.10.38 (legacy build)

Used by `script-import/` to read text and positions from screenplay PDFs, entirely in the browser.

- Package: `pdfjs-dist@4.10.38` from the npm registry
  (tarball integrity `sha512-/Y3fcFrXEAsMjJXeL9J8+ZG9U01Lbu…`, matches npm's published value).
- Files: `legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs` and `legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`, unmodified.
  The legacy build supports older browsers (including older iOS Safari) than the modern build.
- License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`).
